'''Version 0.9.0.0''' is the official patch released on 14 October 2026. This wiki shows 0.9.0.0 values. This page lists what is new and every documented value that changed from 0.8.1.5, the previous official version.

'''Spoilers:''' this page names late-story content.

== Public test build ==
The same content was tested a day earlier as '''version 0.8.9.9''' on the Steam beta branch ''next_version_tester'', which has since been removed. Every item, creature, price, drop and rule on this page is the same in 0.8.9.9 and 0.9.0.0. The official release adds only fixes and polish:
* Rotating an item you are moving in your inventory plays a sound.
* New character names are cleaned of characters that cannot be used in file names before the game checks for an existing character with the same name.
* More fixes for rafts that were duplicated or went missing after saving or changing area.
* Flying creatures keep their flying height when the game snaps them back onto their tile.

== New content ==
=== Story ===
* The main quest continues after Scaal: Eir [[Quests and journal#quest-Eir's_Clay?_topic_(dialogue)|hints at a magical key]], and after the [[Quests and journal#quest-Survivors'_camp:_earning_Wilda's_trust|Survivors' camp quest]] Grand Mother sells the shard that opens [[Quests and journal#quest-Into_Clay's_realm|Clay's hidden realm]], where you face [[Magus Clay (boss)]]. Two new journal entries follow.

=== Survivors' camp ===
* The [[Survivors' camp]] appears in the first Savage Mirk area you enter. In older saves it appears the next time you enter one.
* [[Wilda]] trades and asks you to hunt [[The Terror]] and bring back the [[Head of The Terror]].
* [[Grand Mother]] lives in the camp's main hut. Her blessing grants a skill point, and she sells magic weapons.
* [[Survivor]] guards protect the camp. A Survivor's corpse holds [[Survivor loot|random treasure]].

=== Creatures ===
* [[Mirkfang]], [[Giant Mirkfang]] and [[Mirkfang Matriarch]] hunt at night and roost in caves by day.
* Two bosses: [[The Terror]] and [[Magus Clay (boss)]].
* New damage type: [[Leeching]].

=== Items ===
* [[Magic weapons]]: [[Orb of Poison]], [[Orb of Greater Poison]], [[Orb of Fire]], [[Orb of Greater Fire]], [[Orb of Iron Essence]], [[Orb of Steel Essence]], [[Orb of Wind]], [[Orb of Storm]] and [[Staff of The Fire Eater]].
* [[Storage Chest]], a placeable chest that keeps its contents safe.
* [[Magus' Shard]], [[Clays' Magus Hood]], [[Magi's Ropebelt]], [[Head of The Terror]], [[Bat Hide]], [[Bat Meat]] and [[Grilled Bat Meat]] (cooked at a [[Campfire]]).

=== Controls ===
* [[Strict move]]: hold Left Ctrl to walk to a tile without interacting with what is there.
* [[Placing objects]]: press the Weapon Swap key while placing to flip an object.
* Item tooltips now show weapon range. Every weapon page lists its attack range.

|-

|-

|-
| The Terror near Fort Solid and the [[Survivors' camp]] || Could approach || Keeps away
|-
| [[Loot tables|Loot amount]] ranges || From the low value to low + high - 1 || From the low value to the high value, so ranges starting at 2 or more shrank and ranges starting at 0 grew by one
|-
| Tooltip on/off setting || Reset on every load || Saved per character
|-
| Entering an area || No save || Saves the game
|-
| No-build zone around the [[Survivors' camp]] || None || About 26 tiles
|-
| [[Map Drawing Kit]] || Used up by any outdoor map || Not used up if you already carry a map of the current area
|-

|-
| Fire-lighting bonus from nearby fire || The fire being relit, or one nearby campfire || Every burning fire or placed torch within 1.5 tiles (torches count a third), plus 30% per lit torch in hand, up to 100%
|-
| Sleeping-place concealment indoors and underground || Full || Halved
|-
| Raving Unwanted share of cave spawns || 2% || 2.5%
|-
| Creatures chasing you || Kept chasing within range || Each turn, keep chasing 82.5% of the time beyond 1.5 times their targeting distance, 65% beyond 2 times and 50% beyond 2.5 times
|-
| Idle creatures and other creatures || Targeted normally || Wildlife, Giant Slugs, Toadkin, the Nightmare faction, trolls and Mirkfangs ignore non-player targets 60% of the time
|-
| [[Random treasure]] candidates || 0.8.1.5 items only || Also the new orbs, staff, belt and bat items
|}

=== Story ===
* [[Quests and journal#quest-A_possible_homecoming|A possible homecoming]] is no longer the last journal entry: [[Quests and journal#quest-Clay_defeated|Clay defeated]] and [[Quests and journal#quest-Peace_at_Fort_Solid|Peace at Fort Solid]] follow.
